impact: A relief bounce for HOOD, but crypto and brokers remain sensitive to December hike bets; a hot PPI on Friday could undo it.
summary: Robinhood rose about 4.9% to around $85 and Coinbase about 4% to around $137 on Wednesday, bouncing after Tuesday's CPI-driven drop. Both are still down roughly 23% to 26% over the past month. Bitcoin edged up to about $74,400 after falling to about $73,000 on Tuesday.
title: Robinhood up ~5%, Coinbase ~4% as bitcoin steadies near $74K
